bugs.title: RFQ wizard steps 1-6 are not clickable — no click handlers on .step elements
bugs.description: Each of the 6 wizard steps was clicked individually: zero response every time. .step elements have no onclick, no cursor:pointer, no aria — state (current/done classes + ✓ marks) never changes. Only Continue/Back buttons work.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Section 08b → RFQ Wizard → click any step (1-6).
bugs.expected: Clicked step becomes current (gold ring), per 'clickable steps' claim.
bugs.actual: No state change on any of the 6 steps (verified via class inspection after click).
bugs.suggested_fix: Add click handlers: steps.forEach((s,i)=>s.addEventListener('click',()=>jumpToStep(i))) — jumpToStep sets current/done classes and ✓ marks; add cursor:pointer + role=button + aria-current.

bugs.title: Tabs never switch — atoms (4 tabs) and calendar (Day 1-7) tab bars are dead
bugs.description: Every tab clicked in both groups: .active class never moves from the first tab, no panels exist to switch (0 [role=tabpanel]/.tab-panel in DOM), no onclick handlers, yet cursor:pointer implies interactivity. Misleading affordance.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Section 07 atoms → click 'Deal sheet' tab; section 10 data → click 'Day 2' tab.
bugs.expected: Active state moves to clicked tab; associated panel/view switches.
bugs.actual: active stays on tab 0 in both groups; no panel change (none exist).
bugs.suggested_fix: Add a delegated handler: document.querySelectorAll('.tabs').forEach(g=>g.addEventListener('click',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('.tab'); if(!t)return; g.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active')); t.classList.add('active');})) and wire day-tab clicks to the itinerary content.

bugs.title: Radio set is non-interactive decoration — no inputs, no toggle, no single-select
bugs.description: Radio-look labels ('Round-trip flights included', 'Visa assistance needed') are styled <span>s inside <label>s with no <input type=radio>. Clicking causes zero visual change; not focusable (tabIndex -1); single-select enforcement impossible without inputs. Claimed 'real, interactive (from V62)' is false.
bugs.expected: Radio fills; first radio deselects (single-select); keyboard operable.
bugs.actual: Zero response; outerHTML identical before/after click.
bugs.suggested_fix: Replace decorative spans with real <input type=radio name=trip-options> + <input type=checkbox>, CSS :checked sibling selectors for visuals — gives toggle, single-select, and keyboard support for free.

bugs.title: Checkbox set is non-interactive decoration — no inputs, no toggle
bugs.description: Checkbox-look labels ('Airport transfers' pre-checked, 'Travel insurance') are styled spans with no <input type=checkbox>. Clicking 'Travel insurance' causes zero visual change; not focusable.
bugs.suggested_fix: Same as C03 — real checkbox inputs with :checked-based styling.

bugs.title: Search bar is a static <div> — cannot type into it
bugs.description: The '⌕ Search RFQs…' workbench search element is a non-editable <div> (not input/textarea/contenteditable): no focus, no value, typing impossible, no handlers. 'Real, interactive' claim false for this component.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Section 09b → Search + filter bar → click the search box → type.
bugs.actual: div ignores input entirely; cursor=auto, isContentEditable=false.
bugs.suggested_fix: Replace with <input type=search placeholder='Search RFQs…'> keeping the same styling (padding/border-radius).

bugs.title: Filter chips cannot be removed — no click handlers on ✕ chips
bugs.description: Filter chips ('Thailand ✕', 'Mar 2026 ✕') are .badge spans with no onclick. Clicking ✕ (also 10x rapid) removes nothing. Claimed 'removable chips' is false.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Section 09b → click ✕ on the 'Thailand' chip (or 10x fast).
bugs.expected: Chip removed from the filter bar.
bugs.actual: Still 2 chips after 1 click and after 10 rapid clicks.
bugs.suggested_fix: Add onclick to each chip (or delegated handler on the chip bar): chip.remove() on ✕ click; 'Clear all' removes all chips.

bugs.title: 'Clear all' chip does not clear filters — no handler
bugs.description: 'Clear all' badge has no onclick; after click both chips remain. Contradicts its own section copy: 'Filters never trap the user — always one click to clear all.'
bugs.expected: All filter chips removed in one click.
bugs.suggested_fix: Add handler removing all chip elements and resetting filter state.

bugs.title: Money field: no Indian grouping on user input
bugs.description: ₹ prefix stays and does not overlap the value, but typing '987654' leaves raw unformatted digits — grouping ('9,87,654') exists only in the pre-filled demo value; no formatting JS is attached to the input. Section copy promises 'Indian grouping'.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Section 09b → Budget per person → clear field → type 987654.
bugs.expected: Value formats to 9,87,654 on input (Indian grouping).
bugs.suggested_fix: input.addEventListener('input', e=>{ const digits=e.target.value.replace(/\D/g,''); /* Indian grouping: last 3, then 2s */ e.target.value=digits.replace(/(\d)(?=(\d\d)+\d$)/,'$1,').replace(/(\d)(?=(\d\d)+$)/g,'$1,'); }) — strip non-digits first.

bugs.title: No copy buttons or clipboard actions exist anywhere on the page
bugs.description: Zero buttons with copy/clipboard behavior found (0 clipboard/execCommand references in the whole document). The component library ships no copy affordance despite the interactive-library claim.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Search the page for any copy button or navigator.clipboard call.
bugs.expected: Copy buttons present on copyable content (tokens, code, quotes).
bugs.suggested_fix: Add copy buttons to swatch hex values / token names: navigator.clipboard.writeText(text) + toast('Copied …') on success.

bugs.title: Zero <form> elements — no native validation or submit semantics
bugs.description: The Forms section and wizard demo contain no <form>: fields are bare inputs with no name/required/validation JS/submit handler. Empty-input submit is undefined (Enter does nothing, no error state appears on empty money field). Copy promises 'Every field: label, input, hint, error. Every form: loading, empty, error states.'
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Inspect DOM: document.querySelectorAll('form').length === 0; press Enter on empty Destination; clear money field.
bugs.expected: Form wrapper with validation, or JS validation with visible error states.
bugs.actual: No form, no validation, no error surfaced on empty submit.
bugs.suggested_fix: Wrap wizard fields in <form novalidate> with JS validation: on submit/Enter, check required fields and toggle .error class + .err-msg visibility per field.

bugs.title: Money field accepts 40 chars with no clamp/maxlength
bugs.description: 40-digit input accepted in full (no maxLength attribute, no input clamping); value overflows visually in the right-aligned box.
bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Type 40 digits into Budget per person.
bugs.suggested_fix: Add maxLength=12 (≈ ₹99,99,99,999) or clamp digits in the formatter from C08.

bugs.title: Stepper clamp contradicts stated 'max 30 pax' copy
bugs.description: Clamping itself works correctly (adults 1-15, children 0-8, verified with 15+ rapid clicks), but the copy directly below says 'Min 1 adult · max 30 pax' — 30 pax is unreachable (15+8=23 combined max).
bugs.suggested_fix: Align copy with code (max 15 adults + 8 children) or raise stepper max to make 30 pax reachable.
